headline_fact: Wheat futures rose to $6.75 a bushel on August 14, 2026 (up 3.37% on the day), close to the two-year high of $7.08 set on July 22, after Ukrainian drone strikes halted operations at Russia's Novorossiysk grain export terminal and consultancy IKAR cut its 2026/27 Russian wheat export forecast.
narration_script: According to Trading Economics, wheat futures reached $6.75 per bushel on August 14, up 3.37% from the previous day and approaching a two-year high of $7.08 set in July.
on_screen_text: Wheat Futures Surge: $6.75 - Near Two-Year High
